tasks.short: Issue trading stamps and redeem coupons

steps.what: Inspect the presented stamps or coupons and capture their codes
outputs: captured voucher code and basket reference

steps.what: Check coupon eligibility and the applicable stamp entitlement
inputs: captured voucher code and basket reference

steps.what: Enter the coupon redemption or stamp issue in the till transaction
Check and hand the stamps or redemption confirmation to the customer

tasks.design: Configure current promotion references and native voucher-entry shortcuts in {OTHER}, the point-of-sale system. The cashier captures the actual code, resolves eligibility and hands over the checked entitlement; this adds no separate redemption log.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual promotion lookup and repeated voucher field entry can slow redemption.
tasks.enabler_now: Native till rules and transaction forms can reuse the captured basket and code.
tasks.still_hard: Damaged vouchers, exclusions and disputed eligibility need a person.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier explains and resolves the customer's specific exception.
tasks.altitude: Reduce routine coupon navigation and entry while retaining customer handling.

evidence.claim: Native till eligibility references and entry shortcuts are a plausible configuration; no local saving is measured in the digest.

assumptions: European vouchers and loyalty stamps are the applicable analogue; US food-stamp rules are not assumed. The task includes actual till entry and customer handover, without inventing a second record.

The cashier produces voucher code and basket reference in s1 with all25 capture hours retained. Promotion staff maintain terms in existing duties; the cashier checks applicability in s2. Unreadable codes or absent terms use manual lookup and entry.

OTHER is the point-of-sale system. Native rule views remove six of15 lookup hours; basket/code reuse removes seven of35 repeated entry hours. Actual transaction confirmation and same-system saving remain retained without a self-approval stage.
No machine sends, new promotion engine or automatic customer decision is proposed.
unknowns: Whether the present till already uses the same voucher shortcuts
research_questions: Which current voucher fields are retyped after scanning rather than reused by the till?

already_counted.description: Code capture, eligibility checks and actual entry remain in s1 through s3.

incremental.description: Cashier checks revised voucher shortcuts after promotion changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact customer transaction, redemption amount or stamp quantity and physical handover checked immediately before delivery; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R87, gross13 less upkeep1 gives net12. Low0 retains all current work when these native functions are already active and no change is adopted. High8 retains11 eligibility hours and30 transaction-entry hours plus50 capture/handover hours: R91, net8 after upkeep1. Central requires compatible promotion references and retains nine eligibility and28 entry hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Post charges to guest or patient accounts

steps.what: Capture the charge source and locate the correct guest or patient account
outputs: captured charge packet with account reference

steps.what: Verify the charge amount, service date and destination account before posting
inputs: captured charge packet with account reference

steps.what: Post the checked charges into the separate account ledger
Check the posting result and resolve rejected or duplicate account charges

tasks.design: Use a native charge-entry view in {OTHER}, the guest or patient account system, and test its existing ledger connector before building an integration to {ERP}. Transfer only the exact cashier-checked charge packet and retain reconciliation and rejected postings with the cashier.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some workflows require the same charge to be keyed into a separate ledger.
tasks.enabler_now: A connector can transfer a stable checked packet with an idempotent charge reference.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong account identity or disputed service evidence cannot be fixed by copying fields.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier establishes which account and charge the source actually supports.
tasks.altitude: Remove genuine second-system rekeying while retaining account verification.

reach.learn: Which posting failures require source clarification

evidence.claim: A charge-to-ledger connector is a plausible deterministic design; the digest treats charge posting as E1 and supplies no measured implementation case.

assumptions: This scenario applies to real rekeying into a second account ledger. An ordinary same-system posting or author save earns no saving. No customer invoice send is added.

The service unit produces the charge document through existing service recording. The cashier captures charge identifier, account identifier, date, amount, currency and tax/category in s1 and verifies the exact packet in s2. Capture remains20 hours and verification25; missing fields are sourced manually before transfer.

OTHER is a guest or patient account system. Native search/defaults remove five of25 locating/repeated-context hours. Only the40 hours of genuine second-system entry are removed by s3; its approval time is fully counted in s2.

The connector stops on missing identity, unmapped category, duplicate identifier or rejected write; s4 retains the manual resolution. It does not infer clinical facts, change charges or send invoices.
unknowns: Whether a second ledger actually requires rekeying
Availability of a supported connector and stable account identifiers
research_questions: Can a test packet post exactly once to the intended account and reconcile to the original amount?

already_counted.description: Charge capture, final packet checking and posting reconciliation remain in s1, s2 and s4.

incremental.description: Cashier checks mapping changes and unmatched posting batches.

approvals.approved_version: Immutable charge identifier, destination account, service date, amount, currency and category snapshot checked in s2; any edited field invalidates approval and stops posting.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R55, gross45 less upkeep2 gives net43. Low20 retains all25 capture hours and18 manual second-ledger hours for unmapped service categories, plus35 verification/reconciliation hours: R78, net20. High35 retains23 capture hours and five manual rekey hours for account exceptions, plus35 other hours: R63, net35. Central assumes compatible identifiers and categories. If no second-system rekey exists, this design is inapplicable and saving is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture transaction items, prices and corrections in the point-of-sale system
Compute transaction totals through existing till arithmetic
Review totals and resolve incorrect prices, voids or missing transactions
Record checked transaction totals in the existing cash-up worksheet

tasks.design: Keep existing arithmetic in {OTHER}, the point-of-sale system, and test its native totals view against the current cash-up worksheet in {SPREADSHEET}. Reuse a compatible native totals layout to remove repeated transcription while retaining capture, correction and worksheet checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: An existing secondary cash-up worksheet can repeat totals already available in the till.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reporting views can present those same totals with the required scope.
tasks.still_hard: A correct sum does not prove that every item and price was captured correctly.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier resolves incorrect source transactions.
tasks.altitude: Reduce secondary totals transcription where it genuinely exists.

reach.learn: Which worksheet fields cannot be obtained from the native till view

evidence.claim: Lightspeed X-Series closing views show expected totals by payment type while staff enter counted amounts; this supports native totals availability, not free cash counting.
The secondary transcription benefit is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: OTHER is the point-of-sale system. Existing till arithmetic is system runtime and excluded from the focal labour denominator; no saving is assigned to it. The worksheet must already be used by cash-office staff or the cashier; no new log is proposed.

The cashier produces item, quantity, price and correction fields in s1 with all45 hours retained. Merchandising maintains price and tax references through existing duties; s3 includes checks and manual correction. Missing lines are captured manually before totals are trusted.

Native configuration precedes custom code. A compatible cash-up layout removes10 of20 transcription hours, retaining10 for selecting the scope, reconciling and entering worksheet-specific information. Ordinary saves have no approval gate or saving.
If the cashier uses only the native till record today, there is no secondary write to remove and no change is adopted.
unknowns: Whether a secondary worksheet is kept and read today
Compatibility of its transaction and payment scopes with native totals
research_questions: Can the native totals view replace actual copied fields without losing the worksheet's required distinctions?

already_counted.description: Transaction correction and retained worksheet work remain in s3 and s4; raw shares are used here.

incremental.description: Cashier checks the selected native totals layout after payment-type changes, per100 focal baseline hours.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 focal B95, R85; existing five system-runtime shares earn no saving. Gross10.526 less focal upkeep1 gives net9.526. Low0 retains the existing native-only process where no secondary worksheet exists and no change is adopted. High6 retains13.35 of20 worksheet shares because payment categories partly differ, plus75 capture/review shares: R88.35, gross7 less upkeep1. Central retains10 worksheet shares with compatible categories.

tasks.short: Sort, count and wrap currency and coins

steps.what: Sort currency and coins by denomination and condition
Count each denomination and check uncertain or damaged currency
Wrap the counted currency and coins in the required denominations

tasks.design: Keep physical sorting, counting and wrapping manual in this software-only design. A {SPREADSHEET} or till template does not manipulate currency or remove a counted step here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work acts on physical notes and coins.
tasks.enabler_now: No software configuration removes the physical operations in this task boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Mixed denominations and damaged currency require handling and checking.
tasks.human_edge: The cashier verifies and prepares the actual money.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in this physical cash-preparation task.

reach.learn: Which wrapping formats are actually required

evidence.claim: Sorting, counting and wrapping physical cash are not removed by a software template; dedicated counting hardware would be a separate equipment change.

assumptions: The boundary includes the physical operations named by the task. It assumes no additional count ledger, deposit send or label record where none is kept today.
The cashier produces physical denomination groups in s1 and checked counts in s2; all capture time remains. No structured count input is assumed for a machine step.

Native till settings, document templates and spreadsheet views were considered; none removes sorting, counting or wrapping. Existing hardware use, if any, is part of today's physical process and earns no new saving.
No new workflow or upkeep is introduced, so incremental labour is zero.
unknowns: Whether physical counting equipment is already used
research_questions: Would an equipment assessment, outside this software design, change the physical work?

already_counted.description: All physical sorting, checking and wrapping remain.

incremental.description: No change and no additional upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R100, gross0 and incremental0 give net0. Both bounds retain physical sorting35, counting40 and wrapping25 hours; no record write is hidden within these shares or newly introduced.

role.altitude: Keep cash handling and account verification personal while removing only genuine duplicate entry.
reach: Accounts receivable staff resolving charge postings
